validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="a">
  <state id="a"><onentry><log label="x" expr="hello world"/></onentry><transition event="go" target="f"/></state><final id="f"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: ecmascript syntax error in `expr`: unexpected `world` after a complete expression
notes: an expression that cannot be parsed raises `error.execution` whenever it is evaluated
diagnostics.help: text in an expression must be a quoted string literal: write `'hello world'`

fixes.message: quote the text as a string literal
